--- create_model_array_of_struct.sql
CREATE MODEL m
INPUT (x ARRAY<STRUCT<a INT64>>)
OUTPUT (y ARRAY<STRUCT<b BOOL, c FLOAT64>>)
REMOTE

--- AST
&ast.CreateModel{
  Remote: 92,
  Name:   &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 13,
    NameEnd: 14,
    Name:    "m",
  },
  InputOutput: &ast.CreateModelInputOutput{
    Input:        15,
    Rparen:       90,
    InputColumns: []*ast.CreateModelColumn{
      &ast.CreateModelColumn{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 22,
          NameEnd: 23,
          Name:    "x",
        },
        DataType: &ast.ArraySchemaType{
          Array:  24,
          Gt:     45,
          Rparen: -1,
          Item:   &ast.StructType{
            Struct: 30,
            Gt:     44,
            Fields: []*ast.StructField{
              &ast.StructField{
                Ident: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 37,
                  NameEnd: 38,
                  Name:    "a",
                },
                Type: &ast.SimpleType{
                  NamePos: 39,
                  Name:    "INT64",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
    OutputColumns: []*ast.CreateModelColumn{
      &ast.CreateModelColumn{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 56,
          NameEnd: 57,
          Name:    "y",
        },
        DataType: &ast.ArraySchemaType{
          Array:  58,
          Gt:     89,
          Rparen: -1,
          Item:   &ast.StructType{
            Struct: 64,
            Gt:     88,
            Fields: []*ast.StructField{
              &ast.StructField{
                Ident: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 71,
                  NameEnd: 72,
                  Name:    "b",
                },
                Type: &ast.SimpleType{
                  NamePos: 73,
                  Name:    "BOOL",
                },
              },
              &ast.StructField{
                Ident: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 79,
                  NameEnd: 80,
                  Name:    "c",
                },
                Type: &ast.SimpleType{
                  NamePos: 81,
                  Name:    "FLOAT64",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE MODEL m INPUT (x ARRAY<STRUCT<a INT64>>) OUTPUT (y ARRAY<STRUCT<b BOOL, c FLOAT64>>) REMOTE
